chunks: and the sixth is to make the body taste the pain of obedience as you (previously) made it taste the sweetness of disobedience.
ai.seo_question: What is the sixth meaning of istighfar according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) identifies this as the sixth pillar of true repentance, emphasizing the psychological and physical discipline required to reverse the habituation to sin. This concept highlights the necessity of actively cultivating a taste for the austerity of worship to counterbalance the previously enjoyed ease of disobedience, a key theme in Shia asceticism (Zuhd).
